title: Synthesis, Characterization, DNA Binding, Biological Significance, and Molecular Docking Approaches of a Palladium(II) Complex with Ciprofloxacin for More Efficient Therapy.
authors: Seddik, Ramy G; Rashidi, Fatma B; Salah-Eldin, Doaa S; Shoukry, Azza A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钯(II)-环丙沙星配合物与CT-DNA的结合机制，采用光谱实验和分子对接，虽属蛋白/核酸-小分子互作且含对接方法，但对象为金属药物-DNA而非TF-DNA体系，方法深度有限，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: To evaluate the biotransformation and the mechanism of binding as well as the biological impact of metal-based- drugs involving Pd(II), known to have high potency and low toxicity for use as anticancer therapeutics, in the present study, a newly synthesized palladium (II) complex, [Pd(CPF)(OH(2))(2)](2+) (where CPF is ciprofloxacin), has been synthesized and characterized and thoroughly evaluated for its antimicrobial properties. The interaction of the diaqua complex with CT-DNA and BSA was studied through various techniques, including UV-vis spectroscopy, thermal denaturation, viscometry, gel electrophoresis, ethanol precipitation, and molecular docking studies. The results indicate that the complex exhibits a robust binding interaction with CT-DNA, possibly via minor groove binding and (or) electrostatic interactions. Furthermore, the complex displays good binding affinity towards BSA, indicating its potential as a target for DNA and BSA in biological media. The invitro cytotoxicity assay reveals that this complex can be classified as a promising cell growth inhibitor against MCF-7, HT-29, and A549. Thus, this newly synthesized palladium (II) complex is a promising candidate for further exploration as a potential anticancer therapeutic.
abstract_zh: 为评估含Pd(II)金属药物的生物转化、结合机制及生物学影响——该类药物因高效低毒而被用作抗癌治疗剂，本研究合成了一种新钯(II)配合物[Pd(CPF)(OH(2))(2)](2+)（其中CPF为环丙沙星），并对其进行了表征及抗菌性能的全面评估。通过多种技术研究了该双水配合物与CT-DNA和BSA的相互作用，包括紫外-可见光谱法、热变性法、粘度法、凝胶电泳、乙醇沉淀法及分子对接研究。结果表明，该配合物与CT-DNA表现出强结合作用，可能通过小沟结合和（或）静电相互作用实现。此外，该配合物对BSA显示出良好的结合亲和力，表明其在生物介质中作为DNA和BSA靶点的潜力。体外细胞毒性实验显示，该配合物可被归类为针对MCF-7、HT-29和A549的有前景的细胞生长抑制剂。因此，这种新合成的钯(II)配合物作为潜在抗癌治疗剂的进一步探索具有广阔前景。
